title: 9tz.7: NNTP SEARCH dispatch + lifecycle handler
description:
What: Wire NNTP SEARCH command into the dispatch and lifecycle layers. Advertise SEARCH in CAPABILITIES.

Algorithm:
1. In dispatch.rs, match arm for Command::Search:
   - If state is not GroupSelected → return Response::new(412, "No newsgroup selected")
   - Otherwise: placeholder Response::new(100, "Article list follows") (actual call in lifecycle.rs)
   Actually: move full logic to lifecycle.rs (similar to OVER pattern).

2. In lifecycle.rs run_command_loop(), add before the generic dispatch():
   if let Command::Search { ref key, ref value } = parsed_cmd {
       let resp = handle_search(stores, ctx, key, value).await;
       writer.write_all(&resp.to_wire_bytes()).await?;
       continue;
   }

3. Implement handle_search(stores, ctx, key, value) -> Response:
   - If ctx.current_group.is_none() → return Response::new(412, "No newsgroup selected")
   - If stores.search_index.is_none() → return Response::new(503, "Search not available")
   - Validate value.len() <= stores.config.search.max_query_len → if over, 501 Syntax error
   - Build query_str from key + value:
     * Subject → subject:"<value>"
     * From → from_header:"<value>"
     * Body → body_text:"<value>"
     * Text → "<value>" (searches all fields)
     * Since → convert RFC 2822 date to unix ts; RangeQuery on date_ts
     * Before → convert RFC 2822 date to unix ts; RangeQuery on date_ts
   - Call search_index.search_in_group(group, query_str, 10000, max_query_len).await
   - On Ok(nums): format multi-line response:
     "100 Article list follows\r\n" + article_nums joined by "\r\n" + "\r\n.\r\n"
   - On Err(QueryTooLong) → 501; Err(Unavailable) → 503; Err(_) → 451 "Program error"

4. In CAPABILITIES response: add "SEARCH" capability line (unconditionally; server returns 503 if disabled).

Defensive rules: Never log query value (may contain sensitive search terms). Convert dates defensively; if RFC 2822 parse fails, return 501 Syntax error. All error paths return typed NNTP codes, never unwrap.

Tests: Integration test: open in-memory stores, POST article, SEARCH BODY finds it.
